title: Trust the negative ratings and save your $$$
text: Trust the negative ratings and save your $$$. Wish I would have read the negative reviews. No way to sugarcoat it - this pan SUCKS and so does the customer service department. So, if you don't believe the negative comments, I have a bridge for sale for you.

product_metadata.title: WaxonWare 11 Inch Ceramic Nonstick Frying Pan/Nonstick Skillet, Large Anti-Warp Non-Toxic PTFE PFOA Free Granite Nonstick Pan, Induction Cooking Compatible, Non-Stick Egg Frying Pan- STONETEC Series

EASY CLEAN UP - With a frying pan nonstick surface, this skillet ensures that your food doesn't stick and makes cleanup a breeze. No more scrubbing or using harsh chemicals - simply wipe the nonstick pan down with a damp cloth and you're done.

DURABLE & VERSATILE - Our frying pans nonstick features an anti-warp design that prevents the pan from warping while the aluminum alloy body ensures even heating. The lightweight & durable design make it a long-lasting addition to your kitchen.

ECO-FRIENDLY & NON TOXIC COATING - Our patented stonetec coating is unlike any other! This Nontoxic frying pan provides a nonstick cooking surface that is free of PTFE & PFOA. Cook with peace of mind, knowing that your food will not be contaminated.

COOK UP A STORM - This 11" nonstick frying pan is perfect for all your cooking needs! The pan's large size is great for multiple servings & cooking larger dishes. With our frying pan, you'll have everything you need to create culinary masterpieces.

PERFECT FOR ANY TYPE OF CUISINE - This skillet is perfect for so many different dishes! Whether you're cooking breakfast, lunch, or dinner, this ceramic pan is up for the task. Click Add to Cart to purchase your Frying Pan now!

HEALTHY COOKING - Say goodbye to unhealthy fats and oils! The nonstick surface of this frying pan allows you to cook without using any unhealthy additives. You'll be able to taste the difference in your food and enjoy healthier meals!

COOK ON ANY STOVETOP - This frying pan is induction compatible, so you can use it with any type of stove. Whether your cooking style is gas, electric, or induction, our nonstick frying pan has you covered.

NEVER BURN YOUR HANDS - This ceramic nonstick frying pan has a stay cool handle that you can use to safely grab or remove from the oven or stove top. The frying pan's bakelite handles are cool to the touch allowing you to cook with ease.
